title: ZFS DMU: evaluate ioctl vs FUSE vs zvol approaches
description: Prototype and benchmark all three approaches: (1) ioctl-based zfs_ioctl extension, (2) FUSE dataset bridge with UNIX socket, (3) zvol + custom object index. Evaluate: privilege requirements, performance, ZFS version portability, implementation complexity. Write a design decision doc selecting one approach. Blocked on: stoa-b37a7fd4.
